name: Milhojas Pastry Lover
niche: reposteria / bakery boutique (postres colombianos, trailer movil)
address_note: Negocio movil (food trailer rosa, marca 'MILHOJAS PASTRYLOVER' visible en la unidad). Google Maps no publica una direccion fija de local; la ficha referencia la zona de Naples, FL (cerca de Airport-Pulling Rd N). Se ve el trailer estacionado en eventos/puntos variables.
hours: No publicadas de forma estable en la ficha (negocio movil); una foto de la ficha muestra horario de tarde/noche tipico de food trailer.

reviews.author: Kevin Williams
reviews.text: Kind people that know exactly how to make what they are selling definitely would go back. They have something that could very well become extremely popular real soon as the most delicious desserts, and healthy as well. Plus they don't mind …

reviews.author: Valentynne Herrera
reviews.text: Absolutely delicious! Everything from Milhojas Pastry Lover is fresh, beautifully made, and tastes amazing. Definitely a must try if you're looking for a sweet treat. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Betsy Peloquin
reviews.text: The service was great and everything looked so wonderful. I had the tres leches with mixed berry mousse. I loved the blackberry sauce! It was very refreshing. I also tried the traditional wafer, which was a dessert I've never had before. It was also quite tasty. Give this place a try!

reviews.author: Arenilla Ayala Sara Sofia
reviews.text: I loved this place. Colombian desserts are delicious, they feel fresh and have a lot of flavor. In addition, the service was very friendly. I will definitely come back and I highly recommend it! 🇨🇴

reviews.author: Sindy Figueroa
reviews.text: Absolutely delicious Colombian desserts! The cholado, merengón, oblea, and milhoja were all amazing and full of flavor. The best part is that most of the ingredients are homemade by the owner, including the dulce de leche and merengues.

services.nota_precios: No hay precios publicos verificables; se cotiza por pedido/evento.
productos_mencionados_en_resenas: Tres leches con mousse de moras
